'''Robotic stilts''' were mechanical [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] used by [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhips]] to appear more [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], in order to fit in better in the humanoid-dominated [[Galactic community|galactic civilizations]].
